records.name: Mardin

Kaos GL's LGBTI+ Human Rights Report 2025 (launched in Ankara, 24 Feb 2026): in 2025 anti-LGBTI+ hostility became explicit state policy — presidential and 'Year of the Family' institutional directives, religious-authority and broadcasting-regulator censorship, one LGBTI+ rights organisation closed; six violations of the right to life documented (three hate-motivated killings, trans people most affected), 89 torture/ill-treatment violations (51 the previous year), 313 liberty violations (about 2.5x the previous year, mostly detention procedure). National monitoring with no provincial breakdown.

records.name: Sakarya
records.current_summary: Model estimate (route 3, best-knowledge delta): Marmara; baseline. Scored relative to the national score (0.15) for Turkey.

sources.claim: Human Rights Watch news release (29 Oct 2025): the leaked 11th Judicial Package would amend the penal and civil codes to criminalise conduct 'contrary to biological sex and general morality' (up to 3 years; participation in same-sex ceremonies up to 4 years), raise the minimum age for gender-affirming care from 18 to 25 with mandatory infertility and multi-evaluation hurdles, and imprison providers (up to 7 years) and patients (up to 3 years); fifteen LGBT groups and the Turkish Medical Association object.
